name: Yahara River
gaugeName: YAHARA RIVER @ EXCHANGE ST BRIDGE AT MC FARLAND,WI
blurb: Yahara River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.routeReview: A designated portage or operating lock is required. The access map is available, but no continuous dotted river path is drawn across the dam.

notices.title: Tenney lock and portage
notices.text: This trip crosses Lake Mendota and reaches Tenney lock and dam. Dane County provides a designated small-craft portage. Use the signed carry or confirm that the staffed lock is operating; do not paddle through the dam.
notices.sourceName: Dane County Parks — Yahara River locks

notices.title: LaFollette lock and portage
notices.text: This trip crosses Lake Kegonsa and reaches LaFollette lock and dam. The canoe launch is below the dam. Use the signed small-craft portage, or confirm lock operation; do not follow the river through the dam.
notices.sourceName: Dane County Parks — Yahara River locks
